judgments.note: Docs name the record fields and a format version, not the layout; reference installed-plugins.ts.
Docs give the file-name shape only; reference uses the UTC ISO day and 8 hex digits of SHA-256 (installed-plugins-store.ts:66).
Docs silent on in-place directories and the marker-age test; the safest reading leaves sources the client does not own untouched.
Docs say no order helps, not which id is refused; reference folder-collision.ts.
Docs require frozen resolution and --ignore-scripts, not the command; reference node-deps-checks.ts:44-45 and the 60_000 ms limit.
Docs say only 'no plugin components at its top level'; reference plugin-folder.ts.
Docs quote each clause, not the joining; reference reload-summary.ts:53 joins with spaces.
Docs describe the Windows case only; reference uninstall-records.ts.
Docs give the own-line rule and three attributes, not these edges; reference plugin-hints.ts.
Added in this pass: the --plugin-url archive limits and no-headers rule were stated as fact with no docs source; reference session-plugins.ts:65.
errors.md names `EIO or ESTALE` together and says causes 'include'.
The docs' parenthesis names implementation categories; the prefix and the refused line stay quoted.
errors.md states the routing per section in the same words (rechecked for the permission-rule warnings and Denying Bash).
